x-m-m2-06.goal: Ngokusebenzisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-slope ne-y-intercept yomsebenzi omaqondana odlula endaweni eyodwa, yenza imigqa eminingana ehambisana nezimo bese unquma ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze kunqunywe umugqa owodwa.
x-m-m2-06.material: Iphoyinti P(2, 5) epulanini lezixhumanisi liyiphoyinti elinokuthi i-x-coordinate yalo ingu-2 ne-y-coordinate yalo ingu-5. Yenza imigqa eminingana y = ax + b edlula ephoyintini P, bese ucabanga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo ukuze kunqunywe umugqa owodwa. (Akukho sithombe, futhi sisebenza ngezibalo kuphela.)
x-m-m2-06.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-slope ne-y-intercept emsebenzini omaqondana y=ax+b
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.prompt: Phakathi kwemigqa y = ax + b edlula ephoyintini P(2, 5), yenza imigqa emi-3 ehlukene i-slope yayo a inkulu kuno-0 futhi i-y-intercept yayo b iyinombolo yemvelo. (Ungabhala a njengedesimali. Isibonelo: 1.5)
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ukuze udlule ephoyintini P, y kumele ibe ngu-5 lapho x=2. Uma ufaka lokhu esibalweni, ubuphi ubudlelwano obuvelayo phakathi kuka-a no-b?
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qala ukhethe b eyodwa bese ufanisa a nayo, bese uhlola zonke izimo (iphozithivu, inombolo yemvelo).
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.fail.c1: I-slope a kumele ibe inkulu kuno-0.
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.fail.c2: I-y-intercept b kumele ibe yinombolo yemvelo.
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.fail.c3: Lapho ufaka x=2, y ayibi ngu-5, ngakho ayidluli ephoyintini P.
x-m-m2-06.s.s1.explain: Ukufaka x=2, y=5 ku-y=ax+b kunikeza 2a+b=5. Uma b=1 khona a=2, uma b=2 khona a=1.5, uma b=3 khona a=1, futhi uma b=4 khona a=0.5. Uma b=5 khona a=0, futhi i-slope ayiyiphozithivu. Ngakho kunemigqa emi-4 kuphela ehambisana nezimo.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.prompt: Sifuna ukunquma umugqa owodwa odlula ephoyintini P(2, 5). Khetha wonke amaqembu olwazi ahlanganisa ukuthi, ngelilodwa kuphela kuwo, umugqa unqunywa ube owodwa.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Guqula ucezu ngalunye lolwazi lube yisibalo noma ukungalingani ku-a no-b.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ngalunye ukuthi ukulusebenzisa kanye ne-2a+b=5 kunquma yini bobabili a no-b babe amanani amodwa.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu kukhetha kuhlole ukuthi iphoyinti elilodwa elengeziwe linikeza yini isibalo esisodwa esengeziwe phakathi kuka-a no-b.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.r.b: Qhathanisa nemigqa oyenzile ngaphambilini ukuze ubone ukuthi isimo 'iphozithivu' sinquma inani elilodwa noma siyashiya amanani amaningi.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kukhetha kuhlole ukuthi ukwazi inani le-y-intercept kunquma yini a abe inani elilodwa ngobudlelwano phakathi kuka-a no-b.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.r.d: Ingabe uqhathanise i-x-coordinate ka-R ne-x-coordinate ka-P? Cabanga ukuthi umugqa odlula ephoyintini womabili ungabhalwa yini ngendlela y=ax+b.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.r.e: Lokhu kukhetha kuhlole ukuthi ukwazi inani le-slope kunquma yini b abe inani elilodwa ku-2a+b=5.
x-m-m2-06.s.s2.explain: Isimo sokudlula ephoyintini P siyisibalo esisodwa nje, 2a+b=5, ngakho udinga esinye isibalo. Ukusebenzisa iphoyinti Q(4, 9) kunikeza 4a+b=9, futhi ezibalweni ezimbili a=2, b=1. Uma i-y-intercept ingu-3, khona b=3, ngakho a=1. Uma i-slope ingu-2, khona a=2, ngakho b=1. Isimo sokuthi i-slope iyiphozithivu asinqumi amanani abe elilodwa. U-R(2, 8) unayo i-x-coordinate efanayo no-P, ngakho umugqa odlula kwabo bobabili ume ngqo ku-x-axis futhi awukwazi ukubhalwa ngendlela y=ax+b.

x-m-m2-03.title: Ukuthola iphutha esixazululweni esihlolwe ngo-x=1
x-m-m2-03.goal: Thola umugqa ophosile ekubalweni kwe-monomial, bese uwulungisa ngenkathi uchaza ukuthi kungani inani elisetshenziselwe ukuhlola lingalibonisanga iphutha.
x-m-m2-03.material: USeojin wabala u-(−3x²y)² ÷ 6xy² × 2x futhi wabhala isixazululo esingezansi. Ukuze ahlole, uSeojin wafaka u-x=1, y=1, futhi njengoba kokubili isisho sokuqala nempendulo kunika u-3, uSeojin wacabanga 'kulungile.' (Indlela yokufunda: u-x² u-'x squared,' u-x⁴ u-'x to the 4th power,' no-6xy² u-'6 times x times y squared,' futhi sihlukanisa ngo-6xy² wonke ngemuva kuka-÷.)
x-m-m2-03.prereq.1: Ukufaka izinombolo esikhundleni sezinhlamvu ukuthola inani lesisho
x-m-m2-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa ophosile esixazululweni sikaSeojin futhi uhlole. (Kungase kube neziphutha ezingaphezu kweyodwa.)
x-m-m2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda ubale umugqa owodwa ngesikhathi ukuze ubone ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela ngokulungile yini emphumeleni womugqa ongaphambi kwawo.
x-m-m2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ungasho yini ukuthi isixazululo silungile ngoba nje amanani esisho aphume efanayo, futhi uphinde ubale umugqa ngamunye kusukela emgqeni ongaphambi kwawo.
x-m-m2-03.s.s1.line.4: Ukufaka u-x=1, y=1 kunika u-3 esishweni sokuqala no-3 ku-3x⁶, ngakho isixazululo silungile.
x-m-m2-03.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uphosile. Ekuhlukaniseni, izinkomba zohlamvu olufanayo ziyakhishwa, azengezwa. U-x⁴ ÷ x = x³, ngakho lo mugqa kufanele ube ngu-(3/2)x³, futhi umugqa 4 uba ngu-3x⁴. Umugqa 5 nawo uyinkinga. U-x=1 uhlala ungu-1 noma uthatha amandla amangaki, ngakho noma inkomba iphosile, inani liphuma lifana.
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.prompt: Thola u-(x, y) lapho impendulo kaSeojin u-3x⁶ ihluka khona enanini lesisho sokuqala, futhi ubonise iphutha. Yenza amapheya amabili amanani abo ka-x anamanani aphelele ahlukile. (U-x no-y yizinombolo ezingesona u-0. Bala ngqo futhi uhlole.)
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Faka amanani esishweni sokuqala futhi ubale kuqala, bese ufaka amanani afanayo ku-3x⁶ futhi uqhathanise.
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kungani u-x=1 owakhethwa nguSeojin wawubuthakathaka, futhi ukhethe u-x onesimo esihlukile.
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.fail.c1: U-x no-y akumele babe ngu-0 (uma bengu-0, awukwazi ukuthola inani lesisho ohlukanisa ngaso).
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Inani lesisho sokuqala nenani luka-3x⁶ ahlukile, ngakho iphutha liyabonakala.
x-m-m2-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ngalamanani amanani amabili afana, ngakho iphutha alibonakali.

x-m-m2-03.s.s3.prompt: Lungisa umugqa 3, ubhale impendulo yokugcina elungile, futhi uchaze emshweni owodwa ukuthi kwaphosa kuphi nokuthi kungani.
